newsitem.title: INDIA: Duff & Phelps to start India rating.
newsitem.headline: Duff & Phelps to start India rating.

text.p: Duff & Phelps Credit Rating Co of the United States has been authorised to do a sovereign rating of India, the agency's affiliate in India said on Tuesday.
"This exercise is being carried out in agreement with the Government of India and the team from Duff & Phelps USA will be visiting India in mid July 97," it said in a statement.

The team will be led by David Roberts, managing director international and head of the sovereign ratings group of Duff & Phelps. The president and managing director of Duff & Phelps Credit Rating India will also be a member of the team.

Duff & Phelps Credit Rating Co. is one of the three largest international credit rating agencies, whose ratings are widely recognised in emerging markets, and the only one with an affiliate operating in India.
The team will also meet top officials in the finance and other ministries, the Reserve Bank of India, financial institutions, leading corporates and industry associations.
